limitations: Bounded randomized agreement with a saved solver is not proof of semantic completeness.
rule: The 30x30 input is a crop of a latent 32x32 mosaic fully symmetric under the D4 group with axes at 15.5 (y<->31-y, x<->31-x, and transpose). Rectangular patches are erased to colour 0; the output restores each 0 cell from any of its symmetric partners, leaving all non-zero cells unchanged.
scope: Supported: random transpose-symmetric 16x16 orbit colourings over palettes of 3..9 colours, 1..6 erased rectangles (1..10 per side) that may overlap/adjoin and may touch the un-mirrored rows/columns 0-1, with rejection of any erasure set where some masked cell has no unmasked D4 image inside the crop. Not supported: grids other than 30x30, mirror axes other than 15.5, mosaics lacking the transpose symmetry, masks that need multi-pass repair from invisible partners, or non-rectangular erasures.
constraints: Latent mosaic is exactly D4-symmetric about (15.5, 15.5) on a 32x32 canvas; only the top-left 30x30 crop is shown.
Colour 0 appears only in erased cells; mosaic colours are 1..9.
Every erased cell has at least one unerased symmetric partner inside the 30x30 crop, so the repair is unique and reachable in one pass.
At least one cell is erased, so no example is an identity mapping.
The quadrant's lower triangle is ignored so the latent is always transpose-consistent.
known_limitations: Grid size is intrinsically fixed at 30x30 (crop of a 32x32 symmetric canvas), matching all original fixtures.
The original fixtures are reproduced from explicit quadrant/mask latents; the previous draft's single typo in train pair 0 row 0 of the quadrant ('...46624428' -> '...46662428') has been corrected.
Rectangles whose mates are all masked are rejected via bounded retry (500 attempts) with a safe fallback mask, so very large num_masks values may bias toward smaller holes.
Cells (0,0)-(1,1) and (0,1)/(1,0) have very few in-crop partners, so masks covering both members of such a tiny orbit are rejected rather than repaired.
billing: Claude Max CLI; API credentials excluded; no API fallback

checks: All five original output mosaics verified transpose-symmetric
Latent D4 orbit colouring then cropped and masked; original outputs not reused
Every erased cell has an unmasked visible partner; no answer ambiguity
Fixed 30x30 canvas and offset axes explicitly documented
No archived solver import or file I/O
